description: MCP server for Apple Notes with semantic search and CRUD operations
author: disco-trooper

tool_signatures.name: batch-delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete multiple notes at once. Requires confirm: true for safety.

tool_signatures.name: batch-move
tool_signatures.description: Move multiple notes to a target folder at once.

tool_signatures.name: cancel-index-job
tool_signatures.description: Request cancellation for a running background indexing job

tool_signatures.name: create-note
tool_signatures.description: Create a new note in Apple Notes

tool_signatures.name: delete-note
tool_signatures.description: Delete a note (requires confirm: true for safety)

tool_signatures.name: edit-table
tool_signatures.description: Edit cells in a table within a note. Use for updating table data without rewriting the entire note.

tool_signatures.name: export-graph
tool_signatures.description: Export knowledge graph to JSON or GraphML format for visualization

tool_signatures.name: get-index-job
tool_signatures.description: Get background indexing job status and progress

tool_signatures.name: get-note
tool_signatures.description: Get full content of a note by title

tool_signatures.name: get-tables
tool_signatures.description: Get parsed table data from a note. Returns { title, folder, tableCount, tables: [{ index, rows: string[][], formatting: { bold: boolean }[][] }] }

tool_signatures.name: index-notes
tool_signatures.description: Index all notes for semantic search. Use mode=

tool_signatures.name: list-folders
tool_signatures.description: List all folders in Apple Notes

tool_signatures.name: list-index-jobs
tool_signatures.description: List recent background indexing jobs

tool_signatures.name: list-notes
tool_signatures.description: List notes from Apple Notes with sorting and filtering. Without parameters, shows index statistics.

tool_signatures.name: list-tags
tool_signatures.description: List all tags with occurrence counts

tool_signatures.name: move-note
tool_signatures.description: Move a note to a different folder

tool_signatures.name: purge-index
tool_signatures.description: Delete all indexed data (notes and chunks). Use when switching embedding models or to fix corrupted index.

tool_signatures.name: reindex-note
tool_signatures.description: Re-index a single note after manual edits

tool_signatures.name: related-notes
tool_signatures.description: Find notes related to a source note by tags, links, or semantic similarity

tool_signatures.name: search-by-tag
tool_signatures.description: Find notes with a specific tag

tool_signatures.name: search-notes
tool_signatures.description: Search notes using hybrid vector + fulltext search

tool_signatures.name: start-index-job
tool_signatures.description: Start background indexing job and return job id for polling

tool_signatures.name: update-note
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing note
